definition: the act of trembling.
example_en: Trembling was seen in his hands out of fear.

definition: the act, process or fact of lessening or being lessened.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಮಳೆಯ ಮಗ್ಗುಗೆ ಬೆಳೆಗಾರರನ್ನು ಚಿಂತೆಗೀಡುಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: This year the lessening of the rain worried the farmers.

definition: the plant Swertia decussata of Gentianaceae family.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಶಿಲಾಜಿತು ಗಿಡದ ಬೇರನ್ನು ಔಷಧಿಗೆ ಬಳಸಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor used the root of the silajitu plant for medicine.

definition: the hair on the body of human beings and animals.
example_en: The hair on the hand stood up due to the cold.

definition: the condition of being a slave; bondage; servitude; slavery.
example: ಆ ಜನಾಂಗ ಶತಮಾನಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಕಿಂಕರತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ಬದುಕಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That people lived in servitude for centuries.

definition: a shell in two valves or parts, as of the oyster.
example_en: The fishermen gathered oyster shells from the sea.

definition: a disordered condition of the bodily functions; disease.
example_en: His disease did not cure for weeks.

definition: a ritualistic ceremony performed in a holy place, offering food, oblation to one's dead parents or ancestors.
example_en: The family performed the holy-place ancestral rites at the sacred site.

definition: the reaping of crops; harvest.
example_en: The harvest of sugarcane takes place this month.

definition: to conclude or decide from something known or assumed; derive by reasoning; draw as a conclusion.
example_en: From the evidence, he inferred the truth by reasoning.

definition: a broad-bladed, long-handled tool used for digging, turning up or levelling the soil; a spade.
example: ಅವನು ಮಮ್ಮಟಿಯಿಂದ ಹೊಲದ ಮಣ್ಣನ್ನು ಸಮತಟ್ಟು ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He levelled the field's soil with the spade.

definition: the time following a particular point of time or event.
example_en: No one knows what will happen in the time that follows.

definition: the state of (an animal) being pregnant with an offspring.
example: ಆ ಹಸುವಿನ ಈಲು ಒಂಬತ್ತು ತಿಂಗಳು ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: That cow's pregnancy lasted nine months.

definition: a kind of balm supposed to have the power of discovering the money lost.
example: ಕಳೆದುಹೋದ ಹಣವನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯಲು ಅವನು ದ್ರವ್ಯಾಂಜನವನ್ನು ಬಳಿದನು.
example_en: He applied the money-discovering balm to find the lost money.

definition: a thin crust formed on the surface of something from heat, lack of moisture within, etc.
example_en: A thin crust formed on the surface of the soil due to the heat.

definition: loud or confused shouting; noise.
example_en: Loud, confused noise of people was heard on the street.

definition: the reaping of crops; harvest.

example_en: After the harvest of paddy was finished, they celebrated a festival.

definition: rapidity of motion; speed; haste.
example_en: He came running with great speed.

definition: the correct or real meaning.
example_en: The teacher explained the correct meaning of the verse.

definition: a son of one's grandson or grand daughter.
example_en: A great-grandson was born to that old woman.

definition: the cardinal number sixty; 60.
example_en: There are sixty mangoes in this bag.

definition: a subdivision of a revenue district of a state.
example_en: Our village belongs to this taluk subdivision.

definition: the second marriage of a woman (following the death of her earlier husband); a widow marriage.
example: ಸಮಾಜ ಸುಧಾರಣೆಯ ಫಲವಾಗಿ ಮಱುವಾೞ್ತೆ ಮಾನ್ಯತೆ ಪಡೆಯಿತು.

definition: a girl or woman inher menses period.
example_en: That woman in her menses was taking rest.

definition: an improper time.
example_en: He should not have been called at that improper time.

definition: incessant series of sea waves.
example_en: The incessant series of sea waves were crashing against the shore.

definition: a war of jest.
example_en: The mock war of jest continued among the friends.

definition: a tight clasping; an embrace.
example_en: The mother embraced the child in a tight clasp.

definition: a wall reinforced with bones or pieces of bones.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಕೋಟೆಯ ಬಳಿ ಏಡೂಕ ಗೋಡೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a bone-reinforced wall near the old fort.

definition: a kind of fire-cracker.
example_en: The children celebrated by bursting the fire-cracker during Diwali.

definition: to carry on a trade or business; to trade.
example_en: That family carried on the cloth business.

definition: violent motion; turbulence; wild disorder.
example_en: During the cyclone, violent turbulence arose in the sea.

definition: a material or materials needed commonly by common people, as grains, other food items, etc. sold in a store; goods.

definition: a folk goddess, a form of Tripurasundari (Pārvati).

definition: fine plaster.
example_en: They applied fine plaster to the wall.

definition: a garden; (?).

example_en: There is a small garden behind the house.

definition: the ability, coming from one's knowledge, practice, aptitude, etc., to do something well; skill.
example_en: Everyone admired her skill.

definition: a man who protects, saves or guards; a protector; a saviour.
example_en: That officer was a protector to the people of the town.

definition: to exhibit one's valour; to fight bravely.
example_en: The brave soldiers fought with great valour on the battlefield.

definition: a disgraceful behaviour or conduct.
example_en: His disgraceful conduct in the meeting annoyed everyone.

definition: to take out by scraping, scooping etc.
example_en: The cook scraped and cleaned the bottom of the vessel.

definition: the large entrance room of a house or building; a hall.

definition: the plant Mucuna prurita (=M. puriens) of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The kadavare plant grows in the forest.

definition: causing confusion; perplexing; baffling; bewildering.
example_en: Her words bewildered and baffled everyone.

definition: a class of gods, considered as celestial musicians.
example_en: The gandharvas played music in the sky.

definition: to pass into or through as a pointed instrument does; penetrate; to pierce, stab or penetrate.
example_en: The arrow pierced through the target.

definition: the sharp pain suffered by a woman at the time of or just before, giving birth to a child due to muscular contractions; pangs of childbirth.
example_en: It was hard for her to bear the pangs of childbirth.

definition: miscellaneous, but usu. petty expenses.
example_en: He kept some money for petty expenses.

definition: a homogenous, cohesive relation or association.

definition: devoted attachment to one of the opposite sex; sexual desire;
example_en: His mind became restless because of his sexual desire.

definition: keen eagerness.
example_en: He had a keen eagerness to reach his goal.

definition: (a deficiency, defect) to be present.
example_en: A deficiency of one thousand rupees was present in the accounts.

definition: the quality, state or fact of having a physical body.

definition: a man who cooks food; a cook.
example: ಆ ಹೋಟೆಲಿನ ಪಾಕಿಗ ರುಚಿಯಾದ ಅಡುಗೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: The cook of that hotel makes tasty food.

definition: a percussion instrument consisting of a large hollow hemisphere of copper or brass and a parchment top that can be tightened or loosened to change the pitch; a kettledrum.
example_en: They were playing the kettledrum at the temple festival.

definition: expelled or emitted out; vomited.
example: ಅವನು ಉದ್ಧಾಂತ ಆಹಾರವನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಮುಖ ತಿರುಗಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He turned his face away upon seeing the vomited food.

definition: an order; a command.
example_en: The officer issued a new command.

definition: the fact or state of being associated or joined with; association.
example_en: The association between those two families is old.

definition: that which is produced or created.
example: ಈ ಶಿಲ್ಪ ಕುಶಲಿಯ ಕೈಯಿಂದ ಸೃಷ್ಟ ಆಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This sculpture is created by the hand of a craftsman.

definition: a horizontal, flat and even plane.
example_en: That ground was horizontally level.

definition: keen mental suffering or distress over affliction or loss; sharp sorrow; grief; woe; sadness.
example_en: The grief of poverty afflicted that family.

definition: a fibrous plant, Linum usitatissimum of Linaceae family; Linseed flax.
example_en: The farmers had grown linseed flax in that field.

definition: to squeeze between a finger and the thumb; to pinch.
example_en: The elder brother pinched his younger brother's hand in anger.

definition: poems; poetical works; poetry.
example_en: His poetical works became popular.

definition: to become soft.
example_en: The hair soaked in hot water became soft.

definition: a certificate of marks issued by an educational institute or a university; a marks-card.
example_en: The student showed his marks-card to his parents.

definition: to make predictions; to foretell.

definition: high temperature.
example_en: The temperature was very high that day.

definition: to offer (something) as a bet, stage, as in a wager game.
example: ಜೂಜಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಹಣವನ್ನು ಪಣಿದಂಬೊಯ್ದ.

definition: a sound (in gen.) or the one made by human voice.
example_en: A soft sound was heard from a distance.

definition: hurried action or movement.
example_en: She opened the door with hurried movement.

definition: the bottom surface of the foot; the sole.
example_en: A thorn pricked the sole of his foot.

definition: a heap of fat materials or tallow.
example_en: A heap of fat materials lay in the corner of the kitchen.

definition: being, situated near.
example_en: The exam days are now near at hand.

definition: to become clean.
example_en: The stone became clean in the rainwater.

definition: a man who is niggardly; not generous or liberal; an ignoble, unkind or unfair man.
example: ಆ ಹಲ್ಕಾ ಮನುಷ್ಯ ಯಾರಿಗೂ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That niggardly man never helps anyone.

definition: (vīr.) a Vīraśaiva monastery.
example_en: He was living in the Viraśaiva monastery.

definition: to become serious, grave.
example_en: Hearing his father's words, he became serious.

definition: to resist or oppose boldly or openly; to defy.
example_en: The people defied the injustice and protested.

definition: a twisting or being twisted; an intertwining or curling about.

definition: uncooked arecanut.
example_en: It is difficult to chew an uncooked arecanut.

definition: the bushy tail (as of a horse).
example_en: That horse's bushy tail swayed in the wind.

definition: a human form of which one half is of male and the other female (as of Śiva).
example_en: The half-female form of Shiva is carved in the temple.

definition: a mystic symbol in the form of a cross with four equal arms, each bent in a right-angle extension; swastika.
example_en: They had drawn a swastika symbol on the door of the house.

definition: the small protuberance on a breast through which, in women, the milk passes in suckling baby; the teat; the nipple.
example_en: The baby put the mother's nipple into its mouth.

definition: the joint of finger bones.
example_en: His finger joint swelled up after falling during the game.

definition: a long eye.
example_en: Her long eyes attracted everyone's attention.

definition: a male baffalo (Bubalus bubalis).

definition: the act of giving up something (usu. completely or forever); abandonment.

definition: a wall of moderate height or a hedge, around a building, open space, agricultural field, etc.

definition: a bundle of twisted cord or rope.

definition: to give, bestow or gift.

definition: the plant Citrus medica var. acida of Rutaceae family.
example_en: They sliced the citron in the kitchen and added it to the curry.

definition: the act of looting; plundering.

definition: the entire military sea force of a nation, including vessels, officers, men; naval force of a nation; the navy.

definition: any of several domesticated or wild varieties of a large, strong species (Equus caballus) of perissodactylous mammal having a long, flowing tail, used for transportation, work, etc.; a horse.
example_en: The king mounted a horse and set out for war.

definition: one's sister's son; a nephew.
example: ನನ್ನ ಭಾಗಿನೇಯ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊದಲ ಸ್ಥಾನ ಪಡೆದನು.

definition: a beating, whipping or thrashing; a blow.

definition: to the greatest degree.
example_en: He worked to the greatest degree.

definition: the sun.
example_en: The sun was shining brightly in the sky.

definition: a man who protects; a protector; a guard.
example: ಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ರಕ್ಷಕ ದೇಶದ ಸುರಕ್ಷತೆಯ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ಹೊತ್ತಿದ್ದ.

definition: intelligence.
example_en: His intelligence was known to everyone.

definition: to cook or prepare food.
example_en: The cook quickly cooked and prepared the food.

definition: weakness - a) the state or condition of being weak; b) a lack of resisting power.
example_en: Weakness was seen in him after the illness.

definition: sugar-cane.
example_en: The farmers grew sugar-cane in the field.

example_en: Since grandmother has diabetes, she takes medicine.

definition: a stone.
example_en: A big stone lay on the path.

definition: a kind of plant.

definition: improvement, enhancement of good qualities, merits.

definition: to die; to pass away; to expire.

definition: a sharp, slender weapon (resembling an arrow or a spear ?).

definition: to make ready; to prepare.

definition: toward outside.
example_en: He went outside.

definition: a teacher who teaches arts like singing, dance, physical culture, etc.
example_en: That teacher of arts teaches the children wrestling.

definition: a long sheet of cloth used as a curtain.

definition: the state of being thin and flat.

definition: the dark brown, dull-brown colour.

definition: an alley or passage shut off at one end; a blind alley.

definition: to be multiplied (by another quantity).

definition: having little weight; not heavy.

definition: a tiny, hard particle, as of salt or sand; a granule; a grain.

definition: celebration of the child's birthday after one year of its birth.
example_en: They celebrated the child's first birthday with great joy.

definition: the condition or quality of being fat, stout or corpulent.

definition: the central portion of a house.

definition: a vertical mark tattooed on the forehead.

definition: to roll (something) swiftly from one side to another and vice versa.
example_en: He rolled the barrel across the yard.

definition: the year previous to the current one; the previous year.
example_en: There was less rainfall in the previous year.

definition: a bunch; a cluster.
example_en: A bunch of fruits was hanging on the tree.

definition: a room or a hall adjacent to the entrance hall.
example_en: The guests were seated in the anteroom near the entrance.

definition: the quality of being flexible, soft or supple; softness; flexibility; suppleness.
example_en: I liked the softness of this cloth.

definition: (pl.) two or both the heads; both the ends.

definition: "may it happen"; "may it become".

definition: certainly; surely.

definition: pushed or driven back or away from.

definition: the act or an instance of stabbing or piercing with a pointed weapon.

definition: a stack of straw, hay etc.

example_en: There was a large stack of straw in front of the village house.

definition: a growing sprout (of a plant).
example_en: A growing sprout had come up in the flowerbed.

definition: the planet that we live on; terrestrial globe; the earth.
example_en: Living creatures dwell upon the earth.

definition: any of the wild deers.
example_en: The wild deer was drinking water in the forest.

definition: a man who habitually or repeatedly keeps spitting.

definition: (the moisture) to evaporate; to dry up.
example_en: The moisture evaporated in the heat.

definition: a web spun by a spider; a cobweb.
example_en: A cobweb had formed in the corner of the house.

definition: a name used by an author in place of his or her true name; nom de plume; a pen-name.
example_en: He publishes poems under a pen-name.

definition: a conduit, pipe through which something is supplied.
example_en: Water flowed to the field through the conduit.

definition: rubbed well; honed or whetted well.
example_en: He held the well-honed sword in his hand.

definition: any of several families of primates usu. having a flat, hairless face and a long tail; a monkey.
example_en: Near the temple, a monkey snatched the offering.

definition: agreement in feeling, action, ideas, interests, etc.; peaceable or friendly relations; harmony; an association marked by compatibility.

definition: to cause to become solid, compact; to solidify.

definition: a demand or demanding for something (esp. for payment, returning of something etc.).

definition: having or showing no mercy; merciless; ruthless.
example_en: The merciless king tormented his subjects.

definition: a man who deals in pulses.

example_en: That pulse-dealer had set up a shop of lentils in the market.

definition: the part of the central nervous system enclosed in the cranium of humans and other vertebrates, consisting of a soft, convoluted mass of gray and white matter and serving to control and coordinate the mental and physical actions; the brain.
example_en: That animal's brain was very small.

definition: a disgraced man; a man who has earned discredit for himself.
example_en: Having lied and become a disgraced man, he left the town.

definition: water in the form of vapour or gas by being heated to the boiling point; steam.

definition: petty expenses.

definition: hastily; hurriedly.

definition: ornamented with gold lace.

definition: the quality of being forgetful; forgetfulness.
example_en: As he grew older, his forgetfulness increased.

definition: a piece of blue or dark-blue cloth.

definition: to overpower or dim the vision of with very bright light or moving lights; to dazzle.
example_en: The sun's ray dazzled the eyes.

definition: exactly in the same manner; similarly.

definition: the quality of adhereing, blending with or the fact of being adhered firmly or fused with, another.

definition: from the toe to the tip.

definition: to cause to become or to render (something) useless.

definition: (pl.) the three heads (as of some deities).

definition: dried up (as from heat); that has lost freshness; withered.

definition: the quality or state requiring virtually no effort; effortlessness.

definition: the state of vibrating, wavering.

definition: a complete or abnormally severe forgetfulness.

definition: lack of conformity to truth or fact.

definition: fermented juice made from grape or apple fruits.
